deferral_decision.question: cycle 26 deferred this prereg for TWO reasons. Do they still hold? Decided explicitly, not inherited.
deferral_decision.reason_A_procedural: 'pre-registering at a cycle's tail is what the 12h window exists to prevent'. STILL HOLDS as a rule, and is HONOURED here by pre-registering at the HEAD of cycle 27 and pushing this file UNRUN. The scored runner is sealed by sha256 and is not executed for at least 12 h.
deferral_decision.reason_B_substantive: 'the S3 prereg would have banded its rungs with the rule under attack'. NO LONGER HOLDS. The attack completed: cycle 26 proved ratio = 0.5|1+t| is an IDENTITY (19/19, max rel dev 1.06e-39), m1-L159 (ii) proved the published [0.500,0.543] window is NOT injective (a healthy ladder |t| in [0,0.086] and a degraded one |t| in [2.000,2.086] both satisfy it), the true failure set is |t| > 3 not r > 1/2, and m1 activated his concession at L160 sect3 with the surviving device stated as the tripwire same-sign AND |t| <= 3. A rule whose domain of validity is now known and published is no longer 'under attack'; banding with it is contamination only while the domain is unknown. The band is therefore used here as a DEVICE with its domain named, and every band figure is reported with r and t alongside so that no reader can invert a non-injective statistic.
deferral_decision.new_reason_that_did_NOT_exist_in_cycle_2: this runner is a PORT of the cycle-25 S2 machinery, i.e. exactly trap #117's fingerprint, founded by m1 today. Leg B of this cycle measured #117's prescribed one-point launch anchor and found its firing world is a proper subset of the corruption space. So the prereg carries a TWO-POINT anchor (one undisplaced, one displaced), plus m1's three independent D4 values as a third, cross-machine anchor at the new site. That requirement is new, is satisfied, and is the reason the port is trustworthy.

hypotheses.name: IS D/X_2nd A FAMILY PROPERTY OR A SITE PROPERTY?
hypotheses.claim: at all four composed rungs, D/X_2nd lies inside the pre-registered band H1_PT_band, i.e. D/X_2nd is a function of PT = ||P_b||_G/gap alone and cycle 25's five-point curve is a FAMILY curve.
hypotheses.band_source: power law fitted to cycle 25's three in-PT-range points (19.389,1.120),(56.079,2.140),(84.779,2.927); slope 0.65114563; band = point/2 .. point*2. R3 and R3b are interpolations; R2 (PT 17.80) and R4 (PT 1.38) are EXTRAPOLATIONS below the fitted range and are labelled as such.
hypotheses.fires_against_me_if: 2 or more of the 4 rungs land outside their band => D/X_2nd is a SITE property and cycle-25's regularity does not transfer, which extends my own ERRATUM 10 rather than closing it
hypotheses.firing_set: NON-EMPTY by measurement -- S1's -23.4 at PT 1145 is outside any positive band, so a site CAN fail this
